steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN. Do not start the engine.
Press the down arrow on the steering wheel until the cluster shows Vehicle Info.
Press the right arrow to open Vehicle Info, then use the up or down arrow to pick Oil Life.
Press and hold the right arrow until Reset comes up.
Press the down arrow to pick Yes, then press the right arrow. The oil life goes back to 100%.
Press the up arrow to leave the menu. If the oil change message shows at the next start, the reset did not take; repeat it.
oil.note: Checked in the 2022 and 2023 Ram 2500/3500 owner's manuals. Both also give a backup: ignition in ON/RUN with the engine off, slowly push the accelerator fully to the floor three times within ten seconds, then switch off without touching the brake.

tpms.when: 2022 Ram 2500 (no reset button; the light clears itself)
steps: Set all four road tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
If you are filling tires that are already warm, you may need up to about 4 psi more than the sticker to turn the light off; recheck them cold later.
Drive normally. The truck can take up to 20 minutes above 15 mph to read the new pressures.
Once it has the new readings, the tire display goes back to its normal color and the light goes out by itself.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not clear; have it checked.
